BREKING NEWS:-HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is a virus that causes problems like cough, cold and sore throat. It spreads in winter and spring.

• It can reach the lungs and cause pneumonia.

• When you get affected by this virus, you feel like having a common cold. https://t.co/7g0MZyrY5B
